title: Extending single-minus amplitudes to gravitons
summary: A new preprint extends single-minus amplitudes to gravitons, with GPT-5.2 Pro helping derive and verify nonzero graviton tree amplitudes in quantum gravity.
body: A new preprint extends single-minus amplitudes to gravitons, with GPT-5.2 Pro helping derive and verify nonzero graviton tree amplitudes in quantum gravity.
summaryZh: OpenAI的研究人员利用GPT-5.2 Pro模型在量子引力领域取得了进展，成功推导并验证了非零引力子树振幅。该研究展示了AI在处理高难度科学计算与理论物理推导中的辅助能力。
